sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *según* + a source from B1 Unit 13, and how to report statements with verbs such as *explicar que*, *decir que* and *informar de que*. History is mostly what sources tell us, so this is the grammar of the Suriname lesson: say who claims what, and keep the source apart from your own words.

sections.title: Naming the source
rows: Según los historiadores, miles de africanos huyeron de las plantaciones.
*según* + source + statement: according to historians, thousands of Africans escaped
Los historiadores explican que los cimarrones firmaron tratados de paz.
*explicar que* + clause: historians explain that the maroons signed peace treaties
La prensa informó de que se aprobó un proyecto petrolero en 2024.
*informar de que* + clause: the press reported that an oil project was approved in 2024
Según el censo, en Surinam viven comunidades de muchos orígenes.
a document can be the source too: according to the census

items.spanish: Según los historiadores, miles de africanos esclavizados huyeron de las plantaciones.
items.english: According to historians, thousands of enslaved Africans escaped from the plantations.

items.spanish: Los historiadores explican que los cimarrones firmaron tratados de paz con los holandeses.
items.english: Historians explain that the maroons signed peace treaties with the Dutch.

items.spanish: La prensa informó de que en 2024 se aprobó un gran proyecto de petróleo en el mar.
items.english: The press reported that in 2024 a large offshore oil project was approved.

items.spanish: Según el texto, el neerlandés es la lengua oficial de Surinam.
items.english: According to the text, Dutch is the official language of Suriname.

sections.content: With *informar* you need *de que*: *informó de que*, not *informó que*. After *según* there is no *que*: *según los historiadores*, and the verb that follows is an ordinary indicative. The tense of the reported verb follows the time of the facts: past events in the preterite or the imperfect.
